log.msg: cause found: Screen.sheet() writes to (the forward url) once at build time; Page.render() caches the view so it never rebuilds when a child opens beside it, so Two's box keeps pointing at /two/three/ forever -- clicking it while Three is open just re-navigates to the exact url you are already on, and Router.activate() (shared_depth = whole chain) has nothing to change. Reproduced live: probe confirmed Two's href stayed /two/three/ across every click.

why it was written that way: doc/columns.md is explicit that closing is the crumb strip's job, not an area's ("no to makes a dead area ... the crumb strip is how you come back up") -- every screen.js hop only ever says open the next one. That holds until the box on screen IS the thing it claims to open.

fix landed in public/imagine/screens/screen.js sheet(): click-time check, no re-render needed -- if to is already a prefix of location.pathname, navigate one path segment up from to (the box's own url) instead. In-fence (screens/), no core/ touched.

re-checked all 7 other screens before/after (temporarily reverted screen.js, shot each, reapplied, reshot): quad/stack/read/deck pixel-identical (stack replaces so the box was never reachable once a child opened; read/deck use to=null or their own display:none fix, both untouched). uneven, mix and title gained the same close-on-click for free and it verified clean: golden/thirds -> click Golden -> golden/ -> click again -> golden/thirds/; two/detail -> click Two -> two/ -> click again -> two/detail/; title/document -> click Title -> title/ -> click again -> title/document/. Zero console errors throughout.

assign.outcome:
**Two's box now closes what it opened.** `Screen.sheet()` in `screen.js` wrote a forward `to` url once, at build time, and `Page.render()` caches that view forever — so once Three was open, Two's box still pointed at `/two/three/` and a click just re-navigated to where you already were (Router's `activate()` had nothing to change). Written that way because `doc/columns.md` treats closing as the crumb strip's job, not an area's — true until the box on screen IS the thing it claims to open. Fixed with a click-time check in `sheet()`: if `to` is already open (a prefix of `location.pathname`), navigate one segment up from it instead of forward. In-fence, `screens/` only, no `core/` change.

Verified (headless, 1280, private server): `/divide/two/three/` → click Two → `/divide/two/` and Three's box gone → click Two again → `/divide/two/three/`, Three back. Zero console errors.

All 7 other screens re-shot before/after: Quad, Stack, Read, Deck pixel-identical (Stack's hops fully replace so the box was never reachable once a child opened; Read's own strip and Deck's dead areas are untouched, `to` is null there). Uneven, Mix and Title gained the same close-on-click for free, also verified clean both directions.
